description: mta_sts_error.rs: MtaStsError is a public enum without #[non_exhaustive]. Adding a new variant is a breaking change for any caller with an exhaustive match (including internal tests and the enforcer). RFC 8461 has edge cases not yet covered (e.g. TLSRPT integration), so new variants are expected. Fix: add #[non_exhaustive] to MtaStsError.
title: MtaStsError missing #[non_exhaustive]
